facts.fact: 婴儿出生即害死母亲：Sterling 之母分娩弟弟后死亡
facts.anchor: the baby boy came into the world wailing, only to kill their mother

facts.fact: Sterling 时年十四岁，无正式父亲
facts.anchor: Sterling wasn’t helpless, but she was only fourteen years old

facts.fact: 母亲临终遗言指路外婆家
facts.anchor: Cross through the forest beyond the mountain and past the two rivers. You’ll find her cottage just after the willow trees

facts.fact: 带婴儿弟弟与山羊，行程三倍长；两天穿越森林
facts.anchor: the journey would take three times as long

facts.fact: 归还箭的少年背有王徽刺青，即 Prince Winter
facts.anchor: the royal crest tattooed between his shoulder blades—the tip of a black spear, banded in red ink, piercing upward through a circle. This wasn’t any wolf shifter—this was the Prince of Carnage. Prince Winter

facts.fact: 狼群袭外婆家，外婆被撕碎
facts.anchor: Her grandmother’s arm and leg were torn clean off, her eyes rolling back into her head

facts.fact: Winter 称不杀新生儿，放走条件是带孩子消失
facts.anchor: If I let you go, you’ll take the child and disappear

facts.fact: 结尾立誓杀尽每头参与谋杀的狼，包括王子
facts.anchor: she would kill every single wolf that took part in her grandmother’s murder. Including the prince
